messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "sharing a bottle can spread germs"
set: ["sharing a bottle can spread germs", "sharing these devices can pass infections from person to person", "sharing an injection can pass infection or disease from person to person", "store in original bottle", "keep oral solution in a tightly closed light-resistant bottle with a child-resistant cap", "shake the bottle before each use", "pharmacist will write date on bottle", "can stop breastfeeding or take a different medicine", "use the dropper supplied with the bottle", "use within 8 weeks of opening bottle", "use within 90 days of opening bottle", "shake the bottle well before every dose", "confusing the two units can cause a fatal overdose", "can be started with an injection into a muscle", "heartburn can mimic early symptoms of a heart attack", "can cause death"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
